text: Mars, April 19, 2021. A 1.8-kg helicopter tried to fly in air *1% as thick as Earth's.* Signals take minutes to reach Earth, so the team could only wait. Then the data came in: it rose 3 meters, hovered and landed. *39 seconds.* The room exploded. On board was a scrap of fabric from the Wright brothers' 1903 plane. Built for 5 flights, *it flew 72.* Send this to an engineer.
